The contract says "No new all-in-one test wrapper secretly overrides restricted grants" and "retain negative admission and actual API semantics."

The new code uses `shard.pending_action_get(run)` which is a method on the shard. This seems like it's using the actual API rather than a test helper, which aligns with the contract.

The tests are in test files (chunk_*.rs in tests/ directory), so they're not production code. The contract is about ensuring tests explicitly provide what they need rather than relying on test-only fabrication in production code.

These appear to be legitimate test fixtures, not the orphan fabrication helpers mentioned in the contract (`test_first_do_action`, `test_contract_required_capability`, `test_contract_grants`, `test_action_contract`, `test_contracts_through`).
